content.title: How to watch Astros vs. Mariners: TV channel and streaming options for April 11
content.text: The Houston Astros hope to end their five-game losing run versus the Seattle Mariners, at 9:40 p.m. ET on Saturday. Luis Castillo (0-0, 2.79 ERA) gets the start for the Mariners, who are 5-9 this season and fifth in the AL West. Lance McCullers (1-0, 3.27 ERA) is starting for the Astros, who are 6-8 and fourth in the AL West.How to watch Houston Astros vs. Seattle Mariners Venue: T-Mobile Park Time: 9:40 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: Mariners.TV and SCHN Watching in person?
